email-hide-title-help: Do not show the title in the e-mail header.
email-logo-after-body: Between the body and the footer
email-logo-embed-help: Attaches the logo inside the e-mail itself instead of linking it. Required if Facturalo is not reachable from the internet.
email-logo-position-help: The logo is selected in the Email tab (Logo field).
email-title-help: Title shown in the e-mail header. If left empty, the company name is used.
email-preview-help: Preview with sample data. Unsaved changes to the subject, body and colors are also shown, and the test e-mail is sent with this same content.
